about.en: EDEL is the token of Edel Finance, an on-chain securities lending network for tokenized stocks that accepts tokenized equities from issuers such as xStocks and Ondo as collateral so holders can lend them out for yield and borrowers can take long or short positions. EDEL lives at 0xbf59dbc154421a7b37f4f2841e11f4ed2a1dee7c on Ethereum and BNB Chain, at 0xfb31f85a8367210b2e4ed2360d2da9dc2d2ccc95 on Base and at 5g6wVay8NYQ5Tspo4irj9YqSFfQoPDW7apkX352N29PP on Solana.
